In the Backdrop

So I’ve been in the workforce for 10+ years, since I graduated from college. Well, I did take a little break for around 6 months to prepare for the GRE exam and come to the US. But they are not break, let alone vacation or reset. The preparation and Master program were intense, and I didn’t have time nor energy to step back and analyze my situations.

What I’m thinking

The Meaning of Social

I have never been a social person, parties and social gatherings are rarely enjoyable for me, and I struggle to connect with others in those settings.

As I’ve grown older, I’ve come to realize the importance of getting out of my friend/work bubble sometimes. It’s become clear to me that staying in this routine can be very limiting, especially when I’m not satisfied with my current situation (which happens all the time 😏).

item.title: What I have been up to (Aug & Sep)
item.description:
Motivation for writing this

I have always enjoyed sharing what I have learned, what excites me, and what I am pondering. However, more often than not, the people around me are not as enthusiastic about these topics as I am.

It is understandable, actually. We live in an information-overloaded world, where everyone has a constant feed of social media. I figured that I could write things down for my own future reference. If it could help or inspire someone, that would be a bonus.

item.title: I got my motorcycle back! ✌
item.description:
How it started

I got an internet call(anonymous call) at 11 am, I hesitated a few seconds to answer because most of those calls are just scams, but I took it. It was a female voice saying she is a police officer and my motorcycle is found and it’s in Fremont, she wanted me to stop by ASAP. I was like, What??!! 😮😮 I got ecstatic immediately, my bike has gone missing over 2 weeks, I’ve already crossed off my shopping list for my bike. I said I will be there very soon. I grabbed my helmet and gloves and thinking I might be better riding back in local instead of freeway in case it isn’t in a good shape, as always, I got too optimistic. 🙂
